note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 by an independent auditor after the userns conversion. The unit's only change since the last verdict is userns.Enter(t) as its first statement (the child re-runs the whole body in its own user, network and mount namespace; a child failure or skip propagates to the parent, and a child that ran nothing fails it) plus removal of EPERM/EACCES skips, so a refused privilege now fails instead of skipping. Assertions are byte-identical. Section 4.5: 'There may be times when a dual router has to forward an IP packet to an OSI-only router, or forward an OSI packet to an IP-only router. In this case the packet must be discarded.' IP half: TestRFC1195OSINeighborIsTerminalIPv4NextHop and TestRFC1195NeighborProtocolTransitions (unchanged) pin that an OSI-only neighbor yields no usable IPv4 next hop; TestRFC1195CapabilityChangesInstalledRouteDisposition fails unless the installed route becomes Unreachable and returns to unicast. TestFIBOnLinkAdjacencyAndUnsupportedPrefix installs a usable default as positive control, then the Unreachable route, and fails unless the kernel answers EHOSTUNREACH for 203.0.113.9 instead of the default; withdrawing it must restore the same default gateway, so neither a disappearing route nor a stale discard passes. OSI half: Ze forwards no CLNP packets.
